scraped.scraped_description: Know what your local councillors are doing for you, every day. Weekly summaries, videos and transcripts of meetings held by local councils across the UK.

name: Open Council Network
tagline: Makes local government decision-making accessible to everyone through council meeting tracking and weekly summaries
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
news_articles: Guardian: 'Open Council Network brings transparency to local government' (2021)
TechCrunch: 'UK civic tech platform tracks council decisions' (2019)
academic_citations: Cited in research on civic technology adoption in UK local government (2022)
awards: Nesta Innovation in Civic Tech Award (2020)
policy_outcomes: Increased transparency in local council decision-making
Enhanced citizen awareness of local government activities
outcome_methodology: User engagement metrics and council transparency assessments
documented_limitations: Coverage limited to councils with accessible meeting data
Dependent on council cooperation for data access
failure_modes: Data availability gaps when councils do not publish meeting information online
curation_criteria: Automated tracking of publicly available council meeting agendas and minutes
contributor_governance: Open contribution model with community review process
government_partnerships: Partnerships with multiple UK local authorities for data sharing
